tagline: Reimagining a healthier future for all people, their pets and our planet.
hero_kpi_rationale: Organic sales growth is the primary financial driver of the company's strategy, aiming to generate superior financial performance and total shareholder return.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth excluding the impact of currency, acquisitions and divestitures.
kpis.description: Measures the intrinsic growth of sales by excluding external effects, reflecting the company's ability to sell more of its existing products.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of operational performance and market dynamics.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, representing profit after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Indicates profitability of products sold before accounting for operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Reflects production efficiency and pricing strategy.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in net income attributable to ordinary shareholders.
kpis.description: Indicates the increase in profit generated per share outstanding.
kpis.signal: Direct measure of shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in cash flow generated after deduction of investment expenditures.
kpis.description: Represents the cash a company can use after funding its operations and capital expenditures.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of financial health and capacity to invest and return capital.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total amount spent on tangible and intangible fixed assets.
kpis.description: Spending dedicated to the acquisition or improvement of long-term physical assets.
kpis.signal: Indicates investments in production capacity and innovation.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of net revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates the proportion of revenue dedicated to developing new products and technologies.
kpis.signal: Measures the company's commitment to product innovation.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.description: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.signal: Indicator of operational scale and human resource management strategy.

kpis.name: AI-Enabled Initiatives Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of strategic initiatives or capability enhancements incorporating artificial intelligence.
kpis.description: Measures the integration of AI solutions and capabilities into the company's strategic portfolio.
kpis.signal: Indicates adoption and integration of AI into corporate strategy.

kpis.name: AI Capabilities Development
kpis.explanation: Progress and investments in strengthening data, analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: Reflects initiatives to enhance data, analytics and AI capabilities to support the 2030 strategy.
kpis.signal: Indicator of technological leadership and digital modernization.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and Currency Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: With approximately two-thirds of net sales generated outside the United States and about 45% from emerging markets, the company is exposed to significant foreign currency and exchange rate volatility.

risks.title: Global Trade and Tariff Risk
risks.score_rationale: New U.S. tariffs, trade retaliation and renegotiation of trade agreements (notably USMCA) create inflationary pressures and macroeconomic volatility that affect raw material costs and market accessibility.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk and Regional Conflicts
risks.score_rationale: The war in Ukraine and related geopolitical tensions have impacted operations in the Eurasia region, although not currently material (1% of net sales), with ongoing risks to supply chain and cash flow repatriation.

risks.title: Product Innovation and Development Risk
risks.score_rationale: Growth depends on the success of identifying, developing and launching innovative products. Any failure to innovate quickly or adapt products to changing consumer preferences could negatively impact sales.

risks.title: Retail and Digital Transformation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Rapid changes in the retail landscape, shifts in customer practices (destocking, AI-assisted pricing algorithms, delisting), and adaptation to omnichannel commerce threaten commercial performance if the company does not adjust its strategy.

risks.title: Intangible Asset Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded a $794 million (after-tax) impairment charge in Q4 2025 on goodwill and intangible assets in its skin care business (Filorga) due to lower-than-expected growth and weakened performance in China.

ai_positioning.summary: Colgate-Palmolive recognizes AI as a key strategic capability in its 2030 strategy, aiming to lead in data, analytics and artificial intelligence. The company has enhanced its AI capabilities despite macroeconomic challenges.
evidence: The 2030 strategy identifies leadership in capabilities such as data, analytics and AI as a key element of accelerated growth initiatives.
The 2025 strategic plan includes capacity increases in science-led innovation, digital, data, analytics and artificial intelligence.
